_comment: Backbone/reader profiles are defined in financeharness/providers/profiles.py (the source of truth): gemini (Google) + gpt (OpenAI) + openrouter (aggregator: one key, many vendors) + qwen/qwen-reader (open-weight, over an OpenAI-compatible vLLM endpoint). This file only selects the active default and may override or add profiles (file wins per-name); per-profile base_url and model are also overridable via FH_<NAME>_BASE_URL and FH_<NAME>_MODEL (FH_OPENROUTER_MODEL picks the OpenRouter slug to route to).
